result.summary: The page is largely well structured, but there is a clear text-overlap bug in the 'Popular right now' section and a few smaller consistency issues with carousel cropping and favourite-icon styling.

issues.description: In the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card the metadata line renders two overlapping strings: '25–35 min' and '€0 delivery' are drawn on top of each other ('25–3⁠5⁠0⁠rd⁠elivery'), making both unreadable before the '• Ramen' tag.
issues.suggestion: Render the metadata as a single flex row with consistent gap/separator instead of absolutely positioning or stacking the delivery time and delivery fee labels.

issues.description: The favourite (heart) buttons on the two 'Popular right now' cards use different styles: the first has a white circular background with a dark outline heart, the second has a dark/translucent circle with a white heart.
issues.suggestion: Standardise the favourite button background and icon colour across all cards, or apply a consistent scrim so contrast is uniform regardless of image brightness.

issues.description: The third item in the 'Fastest near you' carousel is truncated mid-title ('Trattoria Piccol') at the screen edge, and the category chip row is similarly clipped ('Healthy' followed by a partially visible chip), giving the impression of cut-off content rather than a scrollable list.
issues.suggestion: Add a fade/gradient edge or ensure the peeking card shows enough width (and ellipsised text) to clearly signal horizontal scrolling.

issues.description: The second 'Popular right now' card is cut off hard by the bottom navigation bar with no bottom padding, so its title and rating are entirely hidden.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content padding equal to the nav bar height so the last card can scroll fully into view.

issues.description: Secondary metadata such as '€0.90 delivery' and the 'DELIVER TO' label are light grey on white, likely below the 4.5:1 contrast requirement.
issues.suggestion: Darken the secondary text colour to meet WCAG AA contrast for small text.
